notes.title: Deja Vu : The Backrooms | Hotfix 1.2.6
notes.notes:
Change Log


 Fixed an issue where the generation seed sometimes created very small maps.
 Resolved a problem where entities could get stuck behind props in Terror Hotel.
 Addressed a major issue with the pause menu.
 Polished the elevator interaction.
 Polished map generation and fixed rare but occurring bugs.
 Fixed other various minor bugs.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update v1.2.5 | 1-4 Co-op
notes.notes:
Deja Vu : The Backrooms now supports 1-4 player co-op mode, expanding from the previous two-player limit. This change was made based on feedback from many players who suggested that a 1-4 player option would enhance the experience.

Change Log


 Fixed issues with pushable objects getting stuck.
 Enhanced chase hallucination visual and sound effects (VFX & SFX).
 Resolved issues with entity target selection.
 Improved and optimized NetCode for better performance.
 Polished pickup and interaction animations.
 Fixed other various minor bugs and glitches.


PS: This version may be unstable and could contain bugs. If you encounter any issues, please report them in the discussions thread or the discord server. Thank you!

notes.title: The Mines | Major Update v1.2
notes.notes:
Descend into The Mines, the newest level in Deja Vu : The Backrooms. Explore shadowy tunnels, uncover hidden horrors, and survive the unknown lurking in the depths.

New Content


 The Mines Level


 Introduction of The Silkweaver Entity.
 Added The Mines Achievement.

 Enhanced gameplay experience with improved chase music.
 Introduced volumetric fog to Pipe Dreams for enhanced atmosphere.

Bug Fixes


 Adjusted the offset for hallucination effects.
 Improved entity hearing mechanics for more immersive interactions.
 Fixed a sound leak issue in Terror Hotel.
 Resolved issues with entity chase mechanics.
 Fixed various bugs related to map generation.

notes.title: Deja Vu : The Backrooms | Update 1.1
notes.notes:
This update includes adjustments and improvements based on player feedback. The changelog lists all modifications made since the launch version.

Change Log

New Features


 Improved Chase Sequences - Chase music and hallucinations have been added to make pursuits more intense and scary!
 Drastically Improved Performance
 Added Animations to the Hallucination Effect (v1.0.3)

Bug Fixes

P.S : The next major update will introduce a new level. In the meantime, there may be a few hotfixes!
